lines.t: The spirit of unity is in Me
Walking in My footsteps, doing unto others
As you would have them do unto you
Remembering that all you do to others
Whether good or bad, you have done also to Me
Have I not spoken to this already
In the Gospel of My servant, John?
For I said to love one another
And to wash each other’s feet
And that you can do nothing apart from Me
Therefore be one in Me
Even as I long to be one with you
Even as The Father and I are One
That our love may be made perfect in One
You in Me, I in you
To the joy of The Father
Says The Lord YahuShua
You in Me, I in you
To the joy of The Father
Says The Lord YahuShua
